mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating signal—defined as PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.8% month-over-month for two consecutive months—indicates rising wage pressures that trigger inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as rate hike fears intensify.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.8% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both HOUST and RSAFS signals strong consumer demand for housing and durable goods, indicating robust private sector spending that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 99.5 for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial output, signaling a contraction in real economic activity that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in GDPC1 growth from a prior contraction—defined as a 2-quarter consecutive increase in annualized GDP growth above 3.0%—signals a recovery in aggregate demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0% for 2 consecutive quarters after prior contraction
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during recovery signals (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising CPIAUCSL and stagnant FEDFUNDS—defined as CPIAUCSL increasing > 0.5% MoM while FEDFUNDS remains unchanged—indicates a lagged monetary policy response, leading to real rate compression and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM increase while FEDFUNDS unchanged
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with delayed policy response
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 20-day returns in > 55% of cases or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 5.0% and rise in PAYEMS above 0.6% MoM signals a tight labor market with strong employment growth, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as rate hike fears rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 99.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a decline in HOUST, indicates a sharp contraction in industrial production and housing demand, signaling a deepening economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 99.0 for 3 consecutive months and HOUST decline
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 in any 3-year window.
